fields.label: Module
fields.description: The product module this plan sells. Defaults to the first registered module.

fields.label: Trial Days
fields.description: Free days after signup before a payment is due. 0 means no trial.

fields.label: Grace Days
fields.description: Days a tenant keeps access after the trial or paid period ends while a payment is due. After that, Desk is locked until payment is verified.

fields.label: Maximum Users
fields.description: How many people can have access to the company's workspace on this plan. Leave blank or 0 for unlimited. When a company has several modules, the highest limit among them applies. Existing users are never removed when the limit is lowered; only new ones are refused.

fields.label: File Storage (MB)
fields.description: Total size of the files a company can upload on this plan, in MB (1024 MB is 1 GB). Leave blank or 0 for unlimited. When a company has several modules, the highest limit applies. Files already uploaded are never deleted; only new uploads are refused.

fields.label: Comparison Features
fields.description: Rows of the side-by-side plan table on the pricing page. Use the same Feature wording on each plan of a module so the plans line up; a plan without a row shows a dash.
